Unresolved information

  • Preparation, quantitative carrier-solvent composition and purity of the supplied 2 M TOP-S stock.
  • Exact physical parent CdSe-core batch, seed dispersion volume/carrier and core storage conditions.
  • Reagent suppliers, purities/lots, flask capacity, stirring, heating rate, gas-flow rate and pressure.
  • Duration to CdO dissolution, numeric injection duration, post-injection temperature trajectory, final bulk hold endpoint and quench.
  • Aliquot masses/volumes; the generic TEM workup sampling time; initial ethanol precipitation amount.
  • Individual centrifugation durations, detailed fraction transfers, final bulk isolation/redispersion and storage.
  • Original Cirillo et al. 2014 flash method is cited but not independently reviewed in this bounded audit.
  • Low-acid absolute OA charge and definition of free-versus-total acid ratio.
  • Exact physical batch identity for the low-OA Figure 1d-f series, its TEM specimen, and any diffraction specimen; no low-OA size or shell-thickness statistic is reported.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • The parent high-OA method lists 5.6 mmol OA/0.25 mmol CdO (22.4 charged ratio), whereas its results use 20:1. The low-OA branch is labeled 3:1, but the free-versus-total acid basis and absolute low-OA charge are unresolved. No high-OA charge or 8.6 nm size is assigned to this branch.
